items.title: Atlassian發布8月分更新，修補旗下產品逾80個漏洞
items.summary: 企業軟體與協作平臺業者Atlassian於8月18日發布資安公告，修補Bamboo、Bitbucket、Confluence、Crowd、Fisheye/Crucible與Jira等軟體超過80個漏洞，涵蓋軟體開發、專案管理、知識協作、原始碼管理及身分管理等用途。

items.title: Anthropic釋出Mythos 5資安能力，企業版可直接掃碼修漏洞
items.summary: Anthropic於周五（8/21）宣布，將旗下最強模型Claude Mythos 5的資安防禦能力擴大提供給企業客戶與資安夥伴，同時宣布成立Defender Advantage Fund（0xDAF），提供價值3500萬美元的Claude使用額度支援開源資安工作，並預告將放寬資安團隊的模型使用限制。

items.title: 中國駭客UAT-10147鎖定易受攻擊伺服器，透過AI打造的工具從事攻擊
items.summary: 上週思科威脅情報團隊Talos指出，他們發現以經濟利益為動機的中國駭客組織UAT-10147，於全球發起大規模攻擊行動，主要針對Windows與Linux網頁伺服器，利用公開的資安漏洞，大規模取得受害組織的初期存取權限，從事搜尋引擎最佳化（SEO）詐欺與資料竊取等多種網路犯罪活動，其中最值得注意的地方，在於駭客將AI工具運用並整合在各個攻擊的環節，涵蓋漏洞利用、偵察、惡意程式

items.title: 駭客組織Ransom Busters號稱能協助勒索軟體受害者復原，並從勒索集團刪除竊得資料
items.summary: 一般而言，為了脅迫受害組織支付贖金，勒索軟體駭客往往會透過雙重勒索的方式，在加密檔案之前外傳到他們控制的伺服器上，藉由資料外洩可能會造成的後續效應向受害組織施壓。然而最近有人打著號稱能協助遭勒索軟體攻擊的企業進行復原，甚至能進一步刪除駭客竊得的資料，引起資安公司的注意。

items.title: Hugging Face傳尋求出售，估值上看130億美元
items.summary: Business Insider本周引述消息來源報導，開源AI平臺Hugging Face正在探索出售的可能性，若交易成真，估值可能超過130億美元。

items.title: Splunk發布8月份更新，修補逾150個漏洞
items.summary: 資安與日誌分析平臺業者Splunk於8月19日發布8份資安公告，修補超過150個漏洞，涵蓋自身的Splunk Enterprise與SOAR平臺，Universal Forwarder代理程式，配套的應用程式與外掛程式，以及第三方元件。

items.title: fix(cron): run history omits cache token counters, leaving token tota…
items.summary: fix(cron): run history omits cache token counters, leaving token totals unexplainable (#124657) * fix(cron): record cache token counters in run telemetry CronUsageSummary declares cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens, the gateway-protocol schema and UI types accept them, and the run-history read path normalizes them, but the single writer of CronRunTelemetry["usage"] never assigned either field. Both values were already in scope and were folded into the total_tokens it did write, so every cron run record reported a total larger than input_tokens + output_tokens with no field explaining the remainder. Operators use run history to attribute token spend per job. Cache reads cost roughly an order of magnitude less than fresh input tokens and the ratio varies per job, so two jobs with identical input_tokens could differ severalfold in real cost with nothing in the record to tell them apart. The remainder was not a usable substitute either: the Math.max against the provider aggregate means it is the cache buckets or a provider total, and no field distinguished the two. Assign both fields when nonzero, matching the adjacent total_tokens guard, so records from providers reporting no cache usage stay byte-identical and historical records keep parsing unchanged. Refs #124647 * test(cron): assert cache counters in diagnostic-events usage record This assertion pinned the pre-fix shape: the fixture reports cacheRead 7 and cacheWrite 3, and expected total_tokens 160 against input 50 + output 100. The 10-token remainder it accepted without comment is exactly the cache buckets, which is the accounting gap this branch fixes. Updated to assert both counters rather than relax the toEqual, so the record stays required to account for its own total. * fix(cron): construct complete run usage without mutation Co-authored-by: Koduri Mahesh Bhushan Chowdary --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
